title: Passage to Chult
epigraph: From the House of Healing to the jungle's edge — by oath, by storm, by ice, by augury.

title: Down the Soshenstar to the Silent City
epigraph: From the cooled town to a hollow city on the bay — by canoe, by lasso, by spared goblin's oath, by creeper-fire, by the amulet off a dead queen's neck, by the guardian left half-woken in the moss, by the guide's parting, by the hatch under the ruin and the road to the forge.
